root_access.reason: sudo is refused by this session's permission profile, not by sudoers
root_access.consequence: the deploy is one owner command; everything provable without root was proved on a shadow contour

inotify_measurement.root_consumption: not measurable without root; the systemd message came from root's accounting

shadow_rehearsal.contour: real Animedia runtime with the adapter + real gateway + a router mimicking the nginx location split

defects_found_and_fixed.what: an ordinary visitor was shown a comment form
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: the widget built the form before learning whether writing was permitted
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the server states can_write; the widget renders no composing surface without it

defects_found_and_fixed.what: a refused visitor was left with an empty widget and a notice
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: the widget revealed itself regardless of the answer
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: on 503 it withdraws entirely; the height reservation became opt-in via --cp-reserve

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the owner's first write failed with 403
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: no CSRF token existed on the page and the adapter passed none
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the gateway issues a double-submit cookie; the widget reads it per request

defects_found_and_fixed.what: contrast ratio 1.2 on the dark theme
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: the widget set a foreground colour but left its background transparent, and Animedia paints its dark ground on a wrapper rather than on body
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the widget paints its own background in both themes

fixture_defect_found.what: the rehearsal router rewrote Host to animedia.icu for every request
fixture_defect_found.consequence: the tenant-isolation check passed for the wrong reason
fixture_defect_found.fix: Host is passed through; only a caller that addressed loopback and named no site is mapped

second_domain.note: animedia.space moved to a newer release while this pilot was being prepared. It was not touched here and is not part of Stage 1. The consequence worth naming: the prepared animedia-01 release is based on fac5643, the commit animedia-01 still runs, so the two domains no longer share a release and the adapter would need rebasing if animedia-01 is later moved to the UX rebuild.
